ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Campaign performance
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Each campaign's budget and cost, reach, accepted sends, visits, leads, orders and invoiced net by currency.
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.basis: Deliveries accepted, visits, leads and placed orders in the period; amounts by currency

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Delivery analysis
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: The sends of a period: accepted, delivered, failed, uncertain, bounces and complaints, opens and clicks with their denominators.
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.basis: Sends released in the period, each recipient once

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Audience growth
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Each list's opening and closing subscribers, grants, withdrawals and expiries, and why people leave.
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.basis: Evidenced consent records of each list, as of the period's boundaries

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Attribution
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Placed orders and leads by their primary campaign, value and invoiced net by currency, unattributed apart.
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.basis: Placed date in the period; each order's primary campaign decision

ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.title: Visits
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.description: Visits of an organization's tracking links and landing pages: each visitor key once, and each visit with no key.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.statusBasis: Link clicks and page visits; never an automated fetch (a scanner, a prefetch) or an open
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.numerator: Distinct visitor keys plus the events with no key
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.additiveDimensions: none (a visitor may visit under several campaigns)
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.exclusions: Automated fetches, opens; a key is set only where the organization's policy or the recipient's consent allows
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.drillContract: The links of the campaign (Campaign performance, TrackingLinkDetail)
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.scopePolicy: A Marketing reader or a Sales report reader of the organization

ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.title: Attributed orders
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.description: Placed sales orders by their one primary campaign, each order once; value by currency is Sales.OrderValue over them.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.statusBasis: The decision in force of each placed sales order (a tracking event, the source opportunity or a staff correction); unattributed apart
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.numerator: Orders whose primary campaign is the campaign
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.exclusions: Purchase orders, templates and orders of an internal customer; an order is never attributed twice
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.drillContract: The orders of the campaign, listed for a reader of each order in Sales or Commerce
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.scopePolicy: A Marketing report reader of the organization
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.freshness: Live; decided after each placement, the attribution job retrying

ironstone.insights.AttentionProvider.title: Registrations waiting
ironstone.insights.AttentionProvider.description: Event registrations paid and waiting for the organizer, or paid after their hold ended and waiting for review.

moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.title: Marketing campaign performance
moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.description: get#CampaignPerformance: for an organization of the user's Marketing report scope (organizationPartyId), the campaigns whose window meets a period (fromDate, thruDate, yyyy-MM-dd; the last 30 days by default) or one campaign (marketingCampaignId, with its children when includeChildren is true): budget and actual cost, accepted sends, reach, visits, leads, qualified leads, registrations, orders and their value and invoiced net by currency (never added across currencies) and ROI where one currency allows it. Aggregates only: no person or address.

artifactGroups.description: Marketing: the audience count service Assist's tool calls

moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.title: Marketing audience counts
moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.description: count#Audience: for a Marketing topic list of the user's scope (topicListId) and optionally its source lists and segments (listIds, segmentIds) and exclusions (excludeListIds, excludeSegmentIds), how many people match and how many fall in each bucket (eligible, suppressed, withdrawn or not subscribed, needs evidence, duplicate address, no valid address, not available) and each reason, with the eligible people who do not allow tracking. Counts only: no name, address or contact id.
